name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer focused on the Lapon Canyon project within the Walker Lane gold trend in Nevada, where recent reverse circulation drilling has returned significant intercepts including 2.62 g/t Au over 41 metres. The company holds a 3% Net Smelter Royalty and an Exploration Stream Earn-in Agreement on Lapon Canyon, with a NI 43-101 resource estimate targeted for 2026. Nevada Canyon is in the exploration stage with a small market capitalisation of approximately $14 million.
